patterns.what_worked: The operator's verbatim spec mapped cleanly onto pure weave.lua helpers (position state, zone bounds, ICD registry) with classes/shaman.lua only rendering - the mutation proofs (clip guard, 2-3 stack gate, Flurry ICD) all landed on the pure layer and were caught by both suites. Lazy widgets kept bars_state's SHAMAN construction counts untouched, so this lane adds zero reconcile debt.
patterns.what_was_hard: The spec's visuals are screenshot-driven with the example link still pending: geometry (band at +18, icons 14px, numbers right of the icons) is constant-driven and documented as the refinement hook. The Flurry ICD (0.5 s) and the sync-threshold=ICD model are operator-provided - no primary source; the reference only tracks Flurry as a buff icon, so the model is marked UNCONFIRMED.
patterns.skill_gap: Offline harness cannot load the addon: the ready/clip/wait feel at 2-3 stacks, the row layout vs the operator's screenshots, and the DW sync warning need the owner's in-client pass.
